### AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT Performance to Dominate Your Game

Powered by the breakthrough AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture, the PowerColor Fighter RX 6750 XT graphics card features 40 Compute Units, 96 MB of all new AMD Infinity Cache and 12GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory, is engineered to deliver ultra-high frame rates and ultimate 1440p gaming experience.

### Fighter Makes Your PC Powerful

The PowerColor Fighter RX 6750 XT graphics card is armed with a dual 90mm cooling fan design, a cooler with an enlarged heatsink surface, and Mute Fan Technology which can run in lower temperatures while providing a stable and outstanding high-performance experience.

### Two Ball Bearing - 4X greater longevity

The cooling fan utilizes two-ball bearing technology, increasing the longevity of the fans by up to 4 times.

### Mute Fan Technology - 0db –Silent gaming

Mute Fan Technology intelligently turns off the fan below 60℃, providing silent gaming during medium and low load while reducing power consumption.

### Unprecedented Ring-fan Blade Design

The newest 9-blade design of our fans generate better airflow and air pressure under the same noise level, improving cooling performance to reduce GPU temperatures by more than 3℃ compared to previous generations.

### Dual Cooling Fan

...

### Performance to Dominate Your Game

The ultimate 1440p game changer. Built on revolutionary AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### Powerhouse Performance for 1440p

AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphics cards deliver serious 1440p gaming and ultra-high frame rates. Get up to 40 high-performance compute units, groundbreaking AMD Infinity Cache, and up to 12GB of dedicated GDDR6 memory. Experience new levels of gaming performance with AMD Smart Access Memory technology when you pair an AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphics card with an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series desktop processor.

### Vivid Visuals

With immersive gaming technologies and support for DirectX® 12 Ultimate, AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphics cards draw you into the action. Experience 1440p gaming with realistic lighting, shadows, and reflections along with rich detail, thanks to DirectX® Raytracing (DXR), variable rate shading (VRS), and AMD FidelityFX features, optimized for AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture.

### Elevated Experiences

Level up to ultimate responsiveness and smooth gaming with low-latency gaming technology from AMD Radeon™ Anti-Lag and AMD Radeon™ Boost. Enhance your gaming experience with the latest HDMI™ 2.1 VRR technology, with over 1300 AMD FreeSync™ gaming displays to choose from, and support for motherboards with PCIe® 4.0 technology.

### Ultimate 1440p Gaming Experience

PowerColor Red Devil RX 6750 XT shares the same cool and stunning exterior of Red Devil RX 6950 XT. The triple-fan cooler is ultra efficient and silent, it keeps the card chilled and extremely quiet even under heavy loads. Red Devil RX 6750 XT is definitely your best choice to enjoy an incredible gaming experience.

### Performance and Reliability

PowerColor Red Devil RX 6750 XT is equipped with three efficient fans (100mm x 90mm x 100mm), an advanced cooler with 6X6Φ nickel plated heatpipes, and a large direct-touch-GPU copper base to provide outstanding cooling performance. Moreover, it features a state-of-the-art PCB design utilizing a 10+2 phase VRM with DrMOS, high quality polymer capacitors, and two 8-pin PCI-E connectors to offer consistent stable power.

1.Back Plate The metal back plate strengthens and protects the card and offers better heat dissipation.

2.Dual BIOS Choosing the BIOS fits your need: better overclocking or silent operation.

3.Stronger components, Better performance DrMOS provides superior power efficiency and better performance while high quality polymer capacitors offer uncompromising reliability. Red Devil is armed with stronger components: a 10+2 phase VRM guarantees better overclocking and stability for true gamers.

4.Cooler Equipped with 6X6Φ heatpipes and 25% more heat sink surface area to offer cooler and quieter performance.

5.Triple Fan The 2X 100mm and 1X 90mm optimized static pressure fan design provides more air flow and better cooling circulation.

6.RGB Featuring RGB on side, shroud, and back plate, the PowerColor Red Devil offers customized and personalized colors.

### Two Ball Bearing - 4X greater longevity

The cooling fan utilizes two-ball bearing technology, increasing the longevity of the fans by up to 4 times

### Mute Fan Technology - 0db –Silent gaming

Mute Fan Technology intelligently turns off the fan below 60℃, providing silent gaming during medium and low load while reducing power consumption.

### Exclusive New Cooling-Fan Design, Advanced Cooling Solution

Compared with previous generation, PowerColor Red Devil RX 6750 XT Graphics Card uses an exclusive new cooling-fan design to increase airflow and air pressure by up to 60%, achieving new level of thermal performance.

### Dominant Triple-Fan Cooler for Ultimate Gaming Experience

Red Devil RX 6750 XT equips an advanced and outstanding cooler with 6X6Φ nickel plated copper heatpipes to ensure the efficiency of heat spread to the heatsink. More fin arrays on the heatsink enlarges the surface area for even more heat dissipation and performance.

...

### Dual BIOS

With the flip of a switch, you can choose OC Mode which allows you to easily handle top-of-the-line games by pushing the limit of the power and performance, while Silent Mode provides an excellent quiet-gaming experience.

### RGB

With the exquisite look, choose your unique RGB effect through the Devil Zone RGB software. Additionally, simply plugging an ARGB LED cable in a motherboard will allow for the Red Devil RGB light to be seamlessly synced with motherboard that enables you immerse yourself in a unique aesthetic atmosphere.

...

### Vivid Visuals

Experience a new level of immersion with the Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphics cards with support for the latest software innovations such as DirectX® 12 Ultimate and the latest AMD FidelityFX™ technology feature set, enabling realistic lighting, shadows, and reflections in extreme detail. AMD FidelityFX™ technology features are optimized for the AMD RDNA™ 2 architecture to power the next generation of gaming visuals at high framerates, providing a mesmerizing gaming experience.

### Elevated Experiences

The new Radeon™ RX 6750 XT graphic cards are optimized for DirectStorage to help reduce load times in games and bring expansive worlds to life in amazing detail. Complete the experience with the widest available display ecosystem on the market, supporting the latest HDMI™ 2.1 VRR technology with the 2000+ AMD FreeSync technology-enabled gaming displays available at high refresh rates. With the new AMD Link™ 5.0, enjoy co-op with up to 4 players and experience your games across different devices seamlessly, as easy as clicking a button.

...

AMD Radeon™ graphics with Windows 11 enables the ultimate gaming experience through superior graphics, amazing performance, optimized security features. With support for DirectX® 12 Ultimate, Auto HDR, AMD Radeon™ graphics, and AMD Software all stand ready to supercharge your gaming experience with Windows 11.

撼讯竞技RX 6750 XT显卡采用突破性的AMD RDNA™2架构，拥有40个计算单元、96 MB全新AMD infinite cache和12GB专用GDDR6内存，旨在提供超高帧率和终极2K游戏体验。

### 竞技版让你的电脑强大

撼讯竞技RX 6750 XT显卡配备了一组双90mm散热风扇、大面积散热鳍片的散热器和静音风扇技术，可以在较低的温度下运行，同时提供稳定和出色的高性能体验。

...

### 强大的 1440p 性能

AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT显卡带来卓越的 1440p 游戏体验与超高的帧率。 多达 40 个高性能计算单元、突破性的 AMD Infinity Cache 以及高达 12GB 的专用 GDDR6 显存。 当 AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT显卡搭配 AMD 锐龙 5000 系列台式处理器时，AMD Smart Access Memory 技术将助力游戏性能更上一层楼。

### 逼真的视觉效果

凭借沉浸式游戏技术和 DirectX® 12 Ultimate 支持，AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT显卡助您畅游游戏世界。 得益于 DirectX® 光线追踪 技术(DXR)、可变速率着色技术(VRS) 和针对 AMD RDNA 2 架构进行优化的 AMD FidelityFX 功能，您可以在逼真的光线、阴影和反射以及丰富的细节下体验 1440p 游戏。

### 升级体验

AMD Radeon Anti-Lag （抗延迟）与 AMD Radeon Boost 带来低延迟游戏技术，带给您全新的卓越响应能力和流畅的游戏体验。最新 HDMI 2.1 VRR 技术可增强您的游戏体验，更有 1300 余款 AMD FreeSync（游戏智能显示）游戏显示器可供选择，同时支持采用 PCIe® 4.0 技术的主板。

### 最新のリングファンブレード設計

当社のファンの最新の9枚羽根設計により、同じ騒音レベルで優れた気流と空気圧が生成されます。これにより、冷却性能が向上し、前世代のファンと比較してGPU温度が3℃以上低下します。

### ゲームを支配するパフォーマンス

既成の概念を打破し、究極の1440Pゲーミングを実現。 革新的なAMD RDNA™ 2アーキテクチャーに基づいて構築されています。

### 1440P向けのパワフルなパフォーマンス

AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT グラフィックス・カードにより、本格的な1440Pゲーミングと超高フレームレートが実現します。 最大40個のハイパフォーマン演算ユニット、画期的なAMD Infinity Cache、最大12GBの専用GDDR6メモリーのメリットをご体験ください。 AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT グラフィックス・カードとAMD Ryzen™ 5000 シリーズ デスクトップ・プロセッサーを組み合わせることで、AMD Smart Access Memoryテクノロジーにより、より高い水準のゲーミング・パフォーマンスを体験することができます。

### 鮮やかなビジュアル

臨場感あふれるゲームを実現するテクノロジーとDirectX® 12 Ultimateのサポートを備えたAMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT グラフィックス・カードを活用して、存分にアクションをお楽しみください。 AMD RDNA™ 2アーキテクチャーに最適化されたDirectX® Raytracing（DXR）、可変レート・シェーディング（VRS）、AMD FidelityFX機能により実現するリアルな光、影、反射が備わった豊かなディテールで1440Pゲーミングをご体験ください。

### 高度なエクスペリエンス

究極の応答性のスムーズなゲーミングが、AMD Radeon™ Anti-LagとAMD Radeon™の低レイテンシー・ゲーム・テクノロジーによりさらにレベルアップします。1,300種類を超えるAMD FreeSync™ゲーミング・ディスプレイ、最新のHDMI™ 2.1 VRRテクノロジー、そしてPCIe® 4.0テクノロジー対応マザーボードで、ゲーミング体験をより高めてください。

### PCとコンソール向けの唯一のゲーミングDNA

AMD RDNA™ 2アーキテクチャーは、次世代ゲームミングPCとコンソールの礎です。

AMD Radeon™ RX 6750 XT 顯示卡採用沉浸式的遊戲技術並支援 DirectX® 12 Ultimate，帶來身臨其境的遊戲體驗。 DirectX® 光線追踪 (DXR)、可變速率著色 (VRS) 和針對 AMD RDNA™ 2 架構最佳化的 AMD FidelityFX 功能可產生逼真的照明、陰影和反光及豐富的細節，帶來 1440p 遊戲體驗。

### 改善的體驗

AMD Radeon™ Anti-Lag 與 AMD Radeon™ Boost 採用低延遲遊戲技術，帶來終極響應速度和流暢的遊戲。最新的 HDMI™ 2.1 VRR 技術、1300 多款可供選擇的 AMD FreeSync™ 遊戲顯示器及對採用 PCIe® 4.0 技術的主機板的支援，帶來增強的遊戲體驗。
